description_en: Updates the settings of common switches
kebab_example: aliyun sas update-common-switch-config --type USER-DEFINE-RULE-SWITCH-TYPE_1900000 --target-default add --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateCommonSwitchConfig

parameters.help_en:
The type of the switch.

You can call the [ListClientUserDefineRules](~~ListClientUserDefineRules~~) or [ListSystemClientRules](~~ListSystemClientRules~~) operation to obtain the type from the response parameter SwitchId
parameters.help_zh:
通用开关类型。
通过[ListClientUserDefineRules](~~ListClientUserDefineRules~~)、[ListSystemClientRules](~~ListSystemClientRules~~)接口的响应参数SwitchId可以获取该参数
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to turn on the switch for newly added servers. Valid values:

add: yes

del: no
parameters.help_zh:
默认是否生效。取值：

add：新增主机默认生效。
del：新增主机默认不生效
parameters.name: target_default

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
